Waiting for a destined person means not doing the harder work: understanding what went wrong in past relationships, building your own stability, figuring out what you actually need (not what the universe "owes" you).

- Talk to a therapist, ideally someone who can help you understand your attachment patterns and why you're drawn to unavailable people
- Create some distance from this person (no contact, muting, whatever helps)
- Reconnect with your friends, even if that conversation is awkward
